title: Quick Order
subtitle: Pay-First Dine-In Ordering
shortDescription: A QR-based dine-in ordering experience where customers build an order and complete payment validation with a cashier.
longDescription: Quick Order is a pay-first dine-in ordering flow: each table gets a QR code, customers build and customize an order from their phone, and the system issues a pending-payment invoice. Nothing reaches the kitchen until the cashier validates payment — keeping the flow fast for customers and verifiable for the business.
problem: Dine-in ordering needed a flow where customers order from the table while payment stays verifiable by the cashier before serving.
solution: A QR table-ordering flow: customers build and customize an order, receive a pending payment invoice, and the cashier validates payment before the order proceeds.
responsibilities: Designed the order-to-payment flow end to end
Built the Laravel API and invoice workflow
Modeled the relational schema for orders, items, and payments

decisions.title: Payment before kitchen
decisions.rationale: A pending invoice validated by the cashier prevents unverified orders from reaching the kitchen.

decisions.title: QR per table
decisions.rationale: Table-scoped QR codes remove account friction — customers order immediately without signing up.

impact: Simplifies order capture and cashier verification flow
